name: Storm Ciarán, Nov 2023
description: Wind speed footprints for windstorm Ciarán, which hit Western Europe on November 1-2 2023 (events 1-3). Three footprints represent the uncertainty in the wind field: they are interpolated from UK Met Office station data using the nearest 15, 30 and 40 stations, giving progressively smoother wind fields.

vulnerability.source: Impact Forecasting damage functions, supplied with the European windstorm scenario
vulnerability.description: Damage functions by occupancy (residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural) and coverage (buildings, contents and business interruption), varying by country and region. Construction type is not used.
